newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's financial stocks sub-index falls 3.20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila's financial stocks sub-index falls 3.20 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange's banking and financial sub-index fell 26.86 points, or 3.20 percent, to 812.07 points at mid-trade on Thursday as banking issues were hounded by concerns over the peso, brokers said.
"Those banks with dollar borrowings are being affected with this talk about the peso," said Noel Reyes, vice-president at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
The financial sub-index posted the biggest loss among the six sub-indices.

The Philippine Central Bank raised overnight rates by two percentage points on Thursday in the wake of renewed speculation brought on by a newspaper report on Wednesday that the Monetary Board would discuss devaluation of the peso.
The report was denied by finance officials.
